book_name: 麻城奇象白蚁 Mironasutitermes machengensis
en: Soldiers have a brownish yellow head and a reddish tinge on the nasus, with sparse short hairs on the head and a few at the nasal tip. Large soldiers occur in two forms: an upturned-nasus form whose nasal tip is level with the vertex and whose nasal base is hollowed, and a flat-nasus form whose tip lies below the vertex over a slightly arched base. Antennae have thirteen segments in large and twelve in small individuals.
soldier: 头褐黄，鼻带赤，胸、腹淡褐，足淡黄。头被稀疏短毛，鼻端有少许短毛。大型兵蚁分翘鼻与平鼻两型：翘鼻型鼻端几与头顶平，鼻基凹下；平鼻型鼻端低于头顶，鼻基稍拱起。两型上颚均具短端刺，触角十三节，第三节较长；前胸背板前叶骨化强，前后缘近平直。中型与平鼻型的大型者相似，头近圆形，触角十二至十三节。小型与中型相似，鼻端明显低于头顶，上颚端刺钝或缺，触角十二节。
taxonomy_note: 原书置于奇象白蚁属 Mironasutitermes，现归入象白蚁属 Nasutitermes。
